title: "Neuro Pattern Recognition"
subtitle: "A day-by-day natural-history companion for the NCCU rotation"

::: {.npr-disclaimer}
**Educational use only.** Not a medical device. Does not replace attending or fellow
supervision, institutional protocols, or clinical judgment. **Do not enter protected health
information.** All clinical content is **DRAFT** pending source verification — see [Sources](sources.qmd).
:::

The Neurocritical Care Society's **ENLS** answers *"what do I do in the first hour."* This tool
addresses a different gap: a trainee two weeks into an NCCU rotation can examine a patient and
list problems, but does not yet carry the **day-by-day mental model** of what a given
subarachnoid hemorrhage patient is most likely to do next — the anticipatory model that a
fellowship builds slowly by osmosis.

**Module 1 is aneurysmal SAH.** The structure (a time × system matrix) is built so that status
epilepticus, TBI, ICH, and others can become sibling modules later.

## The four modes

| | |
|---|---|
| **[Today on the timeline](timeline.qmd)** | Enter a patient's day post-ictus plus a few anchors (grade, modified Fisher, IVH, aneurysm secured, EVD, Na, Hgb). Get where they sit on the natural-history curve, the risks that dominate *today* ranked by salience, targeted assessments, decision thresholds, common trainee errors, red flags, and the evidence behind each. |
| **[Virtual patient](simulator.qmd)** | Advance a scripted SAH patient day by day. Each day: a vignette, a menu of actions, then the natural history is revealed and your choices are scored against a teaching rubric. |
| **[Plan critique](critique.qmd)** | Type your assessment and plan for the day. A guard-railed AI tutor critiques it against the deterministic engine and the evidence — emphasizing *anticipatory* gaps ("you did not mention that day 6 is the start of the DCI window"). |
| **[Evidence cards](evidence.qmd)** | The curated claim / threshold / citation cards that back every recommendation. |

## How it is built

Two layers, deliberately:

1. A **deterministic engine** — a transparent, auditable model of SAH natural history that runs
   entirely in your browser. No server, no cost, works offline. This is the safety-critical core.
2. An **AI tutor layer** — a guard-railed Claude model, called through a server-side proxy so no
   key is exposed, and *fed the deterministic engine's output as ground truth*. It teaches; it
   does not issue orders. The rest of the app works without it.
